content:
pagerduty: PAGER FIRED: service=prod-model-catalog severity=critical — High error rate observed from model-catalog write path (500s) and downstream tokenization mismatches. Trigger: 4.9k errors in 5m. paging on-call for eng-sre. Incident key: PD-INC-11345

incident-bot: Automatic analysis attached: likely regression in catalog defaults after recent automated rollout (2026-03-13 02:14 UTC). Suggested runbook: verify defaultRevision, check tokenizer mapping, consider immediate rollback of affected model revisions.

ash_oncall: ack. I'm oncall for this rotation. Taking lead. :eyes:

jamie_sre: on it with ash. can you drop which model ids are spiking?

ash_oncall: looks like my-company/open-chat-llama and internal/vec-encoder-3. error pattern: tokenizer mismatch errors -> responses with garbled UTF-8 and tokenization exceptions in logs.

sarah_ml: i pulled evals, sample requests show tokenization failing at non-ascii punctuation. suspect the default tokenizer rev bumped to a byte-level tokenizer incompatible with previous versions.

leo_eng: running quick checks now
```bash
# check catalog defaults
rcli catalog get my-company/open-chat-llama --env prod --json | jq '.defaultRevision'
# check recently published revisions
rcli catalog list-revisions my-company/open-chat-llama --since 2026-03-10
```

leo_eng: output (abbreviated):
```
{
  "model": "my-company/open-chat-llama",
  "defaultRevision": "rev-2026-03-13-2",
  "revisions": ["rev-2026-03-10-1","rev-2026-03-12-4","rev-2026-03-13-2"]
}
```

jamie_sre: that rev matches the deploy window reported by the rollout bot. likely bad defaults shipped with rev-2026-03-13-2 (tokenizerType: "byte-level-v2"). previous stable was "utf8-word-v1".

ash_oncall: mitigation options: 1) roll back defaultRevision for affected models to previous stable (fast) 2) hotfix tokenizer mapping in the serving config (safer but slower) 3) route traffic to compatible variant (if exists). I'm going to do rollback for the two highest-impact models and monitor.

priya_support: FYI support: we've received 8 inbound tickets and 4 urgent customer DMs reporting garbled completions. customers affected: acme-corp (prod), beta-analytics (staging->prod bridge), internal demo account. I'll prep a targeted status update if we confirm rollback.

ash_oncall: executing rollback now (will use force flag to ensure immediate default change).
```bash
rcli catalog set-revision --model my-company/open-chat-llama --revision rev-2026-03-12-4 --env prod --force
rcli catalog set-revision --model internal/vec-encoder-3 --revision rev-2026-03-10-1 --env prod --force
```

incident-bot: Command results: both set-revision calls returned 200, defaultRevision updated. Propagation to edge caches may take up to 30s.

leo_eng: verifying downstream runtime behavior — tailing logs for tokenization errors.
```text
[2026-03-15T14:52:35Z] my-company/open-chat-llama request id=abc123 error=tokenizer_mismatch: expected utf8-word-v1 got byte-level-v2
[2026-03-15T14:52:58Z] my-company/open-chat-llama request id=def456 INFO: serving using revision rev-2026-03-12-4
[2026-03-15T14:53:02Z] internal/vec-encoder-3 request id=ghi789 INFO: encoder initialized with tokenizer utf8-word-v1
```

jamie_sre: seeing error rate drop from ~4500/min to ~12/min in the last 60s. CPU/gpu utilization stable.

priya_support: confirmed: 3 previously impacted customers now reporting normal behavior. I'll mark tickets as "mitigated" and keep open for monitoring.

ash_oncall: leaving a quick note for post-incident tasks: - create postmortem with timeline + root cause (probable bad default in automated publish pipeline) - add a pre-merge test that validates tokenizer compatibility for default revisions - add alert to catch sudden defaultRevision changes on high-traffic models - coordinate with release engineer on rollout gating.

jamie_sre: agreed. also add a short-term guard in the catalog service: if tokenizer type for default rev != stable set, don't flip default without a canary window.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-INC-11345 acknowledged by ash_oncall. Escalation paused.

pagerduty: RESOLUTION: page resolved by ash_oncall at 2026-03-15T14:53:30Z. No further escalation.

ash_oncall: thanks team. i'm going to hand this to jamie for postmortem write-up. priya, please follow up with customer comms drafts. i'll file a postmortem ticket and assign actions.

priya_support: will do, drafting customer note now and cc: product and legal for enterprise wording.

jamie_sre: i'll start the postmortem doc and link logs + runbook changes. leaving monitoring on for 2 hours then we'll close the incident. :white_check_mark:

ash_oncall: incident closed in PagerDuty. moving to retrospective.
